newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to protect bankrupt Anchor Glass 's pensions.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to protect bankrupt Anchor Glass 's pensions.

text.p: The Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation said Friday it will protect the underfunded pensions of 15,600 workers and retirees of Anchor Glass Container Corporation, which filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September.
The PBGC said in a news release that it will ask the U.S. District Court in Brooklyn, N.Y., to terminate three of the company's pension plans effective January 9 and to have the PBGC named trustee.
Anchor Glass pension plans are underfunded by about $185 million, the PBGC said.

The Tampa, Fla.,-based glass container manufacturer, which has facilities in 11 states, is in the process of selling its assets. PBGC said that the buyer assuming most of the company can not support the existing pension insurance program.
The PBGC is a federal agency created to guarantee payment of basic pension benefits earned by workers.
